questions.question: An HTML table is used to organize data in terms of what?
Besides organizing data, HTML tables are one way of doing what in a webpage?
Which HTML tag is used to define a table?
Which HTML tag is used to define table headers?
Which HTML tag is used to define table rows?
Which HTML tag is used to define data cells?
The number of rows of a table is determined by what?
options: The number of <tr> elements the table has
The number of <td> elements in each row
The number of <th> elements the table has
The value of the border attribute
questions.correctAnswer: The number of <tr> elements the table has

questions.question: The number of columns of a table is determined by what?
options: The number of <td> elements found in each <tr>
The number of <tr> elements the table has
The number of <table> elements the page has
The value of the colspan attribute
questions.correctAnswer: The number of <td> elements found in each <tr>

questions.question: What does the border attribute do when added to a table?
options: It adds a border to the table when displayed
It changes the background color of the table
It merges the columns of the table
It centers the table on the page
questions.correctAnswer: It adds a border to the table when displayed

questions.question: If the border attribute is not used in a table, how is the data displayed?
options: The data is displayed in the same way but without a border
The data is hidden from the browser
The data is displayed in a single row
The data is displayed with a double border
questions.correctAnswer: The data is displayed in the same way but without a border

In the code <th colspan='2'>Cases</th>, what does the colspan attribute accomplish?
options: It merges two columns so the header spans both of them
It merges two rows so the header spans both of them
It changes the border of the header
It sets the background color of the header
questions.correctAnswer: It merges two columns so the header spans both of them

questions.question: In the page layout example, the code <table width='100%'> makes the table do what?
options: Occupy the entire width of the page
Set the table font size to 100 percent
questions.correctAnswer: Occupy the entire width of the page

questions.question: In the page layout example, what does 'px' stand for?
In the page layout code, the first <td> of the second <tr> is assigned width='20%'. What is the effect of this?
options: The Sidebar occupies 20% of the width of the table
The Content area occupies 20% of the width of the table
The table occupies 20% of the width of the page
The Sidebar has a height of 20 pixels
questions.correctAnswer: The Sidebar occupies 20% of the width of the table

questions.question: In the page layout table example, which attribute is used to merge the top and bottom rows of the table?

options: The background color of the cell
The border thickness of the cell
The number of columns the cell spans
